verdict: The Manifesto is the best-structured deck in the Kayfabizarro corpus — fifteen themed chapters, sixty cards, zero filler. The Cover-Up taxonomy is air-tight and the naming is consistently at its Rogue Animal Name best (Tape-Destroying-Tapir, Black-Site-Badger, Kangaroo-Commission-Crocodile). Weakness: the back half of the deck (Counter-Archive, Century of Fog) runs more G2 than the electrifying first half — not bad, but slightly less table-explosive. Table-ready: YES.
blurb: Sixty cards. One complete anatomy of how cover-ups work. For anyone who ever watched a hearing and thought: wait, this is a game. It is.

marketingText:
Kayfabizarro: HOW TO STAGE A COVER-UP – A Complete Anatomy of Denial, Shredders & Strategic Fog (Free Cut & Play Comic Card Game)

You have sat through this hearing before. The key file went missing, the witness cannot recall, and somehow not one living human being turns out to be responsible. That is not the system failing. That is the choreography working exactly as designed.

You were trained to read a cover-up as incompetence: a lost document, an overworked clerk, an unfortunate gap in the record. So you keep waiting for the one honest official who will finally connect the dots. The dots were never disconnected. Denial has a budget, a schedule, and a cast. The fog rolls in on cue, the shredder runs on overtime, and the loudest distraction always lands the same week the receipts would have started making sense.

This is Social Story Wrestling for the back room: 60 cut-and-play cards that hand you every move in the cover-up playbook as something you run on purpose, out loud, in front of witnesses, until the whole machine is sitting on the table where you can finally see how it fits together.

WHAT'S INSIDE?
- The How To Stage A Cover-Up Core Deck: 60 High-Res "Print, Cut & Play" Cards, featuring The Black-Site-Badger, The Tape-Destroying-Tapir, and The Distraction-Deployment-Dingo.
- The Freestyle Rules: The complete Anti-Rulebook. No complicated math, no security clearance, just storytelling, dice-driven chaos, and the one law that every card can claim anything, as long as you can sell it before the room calls the cover-up.
- The 15-Chapter Anatomy: the deck walks a denial from first flinch to final word, The Scope of Denial, Stacking the Deck, The Art of the Shredder, The Sound of Silence, The Waiting Game, all the way to the Counter-Archive and the Last Word, so you watch the fog assemble itself one chapter at a time.

THE "LIVING DECK" PASS (Free Updates)
Grab this and you are not buying a frozen PDF. You are joining the cover-up cycle. Every future expansion, every freshly redacted variant in this series, lands in your library as a free update. No second checkout, no clearance form, no waiting for the official version to declassify.

WHY "PAY WHAT YOU WANT"?
I make these because a tactic you can name and run yourself is a tactic that stops working on you. Once you have personally staged the shredder and the strategic fog at a kitchen table, you spot the real thing on the news before the anchor finishes the sentence. Broke? Enter "0" and take it. Read it, cut it, play it, and never sit through a hearing the same way again. Want to support the craft? Every dollar goes straight into the time I spend drawing the next cards and sharpening the rules.

Choose your reality. Become an Epistemic Outlaw.
They never win by hiding the truth. They win by out-staging it. Learn the staging, and the show falls apart.
Stay fluffy. — Uncle FrizzleBob
